places.name: Fort St. George
places.blurb: Built in 1644, it was the first English fortress in India and now houses a fascinating colonial-era museum.

places.name: Government Museum Chennai
places.blurb: Visitors explore extensive collections of Roman antiquities, South Indian bronzes, and archaeological treasures.

places.name: Marina Beach
places.blurb: It is the longest natural urban beach in India and a vibrant gathering spot for locals and tourists alike.

places.name: Kapaleeshwarar Temple
places.blurb: This 7th-century architectural marvel dedicated to Lord Shiva showcases classic Dravidian temple design.

places.name: Mahabalipuram Shore Temple
places.blurb: This UNESCO World Heritage site features 8th-century structural rock-cut temples overlooking the Bay of Bengal.

places.name: Pulicat Lake
places.blurb: It is the second-largest brackish-water lagoon in India, famous for flamingo watching and peaceful boat rides.

places.name: Tada Falls
places.blurb: Trekkers and adventure seekers enjoy the rocky trails leading to these multi-tiered jungle waterfalls.

places.name: Auroville
places.blurb: People visit this experimental universal township dedicated to human unity and sustainable living.
